title: Photo-Review Claim Amount: Valuation Standard for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Photo-review claim amount: valuation standard for Cartwise Grocery Orders

**Standard.** For a photo-review claim on a Cartwise Grocery Orders line sold by weight, the photo-review line value is the claimed line's billed charge less the weight-overage refunds standing on it. The photo-review claim amount is the photo-review line value, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Claimed line's billed charge | The billed item line entry of the claimed line |
| Weight-overage refunds standing on it | Item refund entries with the reason weight overage on that line |

The line value is never taken below zero: where the weight-overage refunds standing on the line equal its charge, the line value is 0.

## Valuation examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Billed charge on the claimed line | Weight-overage refunds on it | Line value | Claim amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14.37 | 1.12 | 13.25 | 13.25 |
| 14.37 | none | 14.37 | 14.37 |
| 22.80 | 0.47 | 22.33 | 22.33 |

Only refunds with the reason weight overage are taken off; an item refund for any other reason leaves the line value unchanged.
